locations.name: Studio Movie Grill Bakersfield
locations.parking_notes: Shopping-center parking can be limited when busy.
locations.description: Studio Movie Grill's Bakersfield location, in the Rosedale shopping center. Full bar with a real cocktail menu, reclining seats, and table service via a seat-side button, with a large food menu (funnel cake fries, hummus plate, pizza, burgers) reviewers generally rate well. One recent visit reported a cold burger and burnt pizza, so kitchen consistency varies. Parking can be tight in the shopping center during busy periods.

locations.name: Studio Movie Grill Rocklin
locations.description: Studio Movie Grill's Rocklin location, near Sacramento. In-seat ordering, cocktails (the Kahlua mudslide gets specific praise), and generally good food come up across most reviews. The most recent review, though, describes a sharp decline from what it used to be: a filthy seat that staff had to be asked to clean, dirty carpets, restrooms out of toilet paper, and a sloppily-prepared hummus board — a notably worse account than the visits before it, worth weighing alongside the otherwise-positive history.

locations.name: Studio Movie Grill Simi Valley
locations.description: Studio Movie Grill's Simi Valley location. Reviewers describe a premium-feeling space with comfortable seating, but flag real friction points: a clunky online ticketing flow, food arriving in mismatched batches (an appetizer's dip showing up 15 minutes before the rest of an order), and one visit with a noticeably out-of-focus projector. One reviewer called food and drink prices excessive compared to a nearby competitor. Others report smooth, well-timed service and good food on the same menu.

locations.name: Studio Movie Grill Seminole
locations.description: Studio Movie Grill's Seminole location in the Tampa Bay area. Reclining seats, seat-side service, and a menu reviewers single out for its mini sliders. Most visits are rated highly on comfort, temperature, and service. One reviewer's "Dinner for 2" order arrived cold and, after a manager comped the affected entree, was then charged full price for the rest of the deal rather than the discounted bundle rate — a billing point worth knowing about if you modify that deal.

locations.name: Studio Movie Grill Sunset Walk
locations.description: Studio Movie Grill's Sunset Walk location near Orlando-Kissimmee, in the Margaritaville Resort area. The entrance and lobby are described as upscale, and service is consistently rated as friendly and professional. The recurring complaint, across several independent reviews, is seat condition: the leather upholstery is described as flaking or peeling on many seats, and recline function is inconsistent. Food and picture/sound quality are otherwise rated well.

locations.name: Studio Movie Grill Duluth
locations.description: Studio Movie Grill's Duluth, GA location. Reviews split sharply by visit: several describe outstanding, attentive service and standout food (coconut shrimp gets specific praise), while others describe long service gaps — one reviewer waited over 1.5 hours for a corrected order and payment mix-up, another waited 35 minutes for two milkshakes with repeated staff inattention. A separate review describes a disorganized entry process with unclear communication about theater readiness. Worth going in aware that experience here varies more by visit and staff than at some other locations.

locations.name: Studio Movie Grill Marietta
locations.description: Studio Movie Grill's Marietta location. Hospitality is the standout here — multiple reviewers name specific managers and servers for genuinely warm, unscripted service, and the bar program gets consistent praise. The recurring caveat, raised across several independent reviews, is seating: the theater rooms are described as due for renovation, with worn, dated cushions, though reviewers note visible signs of reinvestment already underway.

locations.name: Studio Movie Grill North Point
locations.accessibility_notes: One reviewer noted wheelchair-accessible seating that allows a guest to sit together with their party rather than being separated.
locations.description: Studio Movie Grill's North Point location in Alpharetta, GA. Consistently strong reviews: comfortable reclining seats, a bar and lounge area, attentive staff, and food reviewers describe as good if slightly pricey. One reviewer specifically noted that wheelchair-accessible seating lets guests sit together with their party rather than being split up. A ticketing mix-up (wrong location purchased) was resolved by staff without hassle in one visit.

locations.name: Studio Movie Grill Wheaton
locations.description: Studio Movie Grill's Wheaton, IL location. Reviewers consistently rate it the cleanest theater in the area, but food is repeatedly described as overpriced for the quality, and several reviews describe drink orders arriving late or getting dropped entirely. Seats do not all recline — reviewers advise specifically selecting reclining seats when booking, and note that even those don't recline as far as at some other chains.

locations.name: Studio Movie Grill Arlington Highlands
locations.description: Studio Movie Grill's Arlington Highlands location. Reviews are split: some describe good food and fair pricing, but a recurring and specific complaint across multiple reviews is seat condition — one reviewer described a seat and footrest as "completely falling apart," and a separate review reports a sound system that stayed noticeably quiet even after being asked twice to turn it up. Table cleanliness is also flagged in at least one review. Other visits describe friendly, helpful staff and smooth service.

locations.name: Studio Movie Grill Arlington Lincoln Square
locations.description: Studio Movie Grill's Arlington Lincoln Square location. Reviews are mixed: several name specific staff for genuinely attentive, well-liked service, but one reviewer described top-row seats that don't recline and servers who stood in the sightline during key movie moments while talking loudly. Food quality is also inconsistent by visit — some reviews describe hot, fresh food, while a couple of recent ones describe cold entrees and stale-tasting fried items.

locations.name: Studio Movie Grill Chisholm Trail
locations.accessibility_notes: Reviewers note wheelchair accessibility and assistive listening devices are available.
locations.description: Studio Movie Grill's Chisholm Trail Ranch location in Fort Worth. Reviewers highlight a strong amenities list — mobile and print-at-home ticketing, a ticket kiosk, wheelchair accessibility, and assistive listening devices — alongside reserved stadium seating and food service reviewers call a genuine highlight of the visit. One review describes a distinctly bad visit (a dirty theater, a server unfamiliar with the menu, food brought out of order, and a curt exchange with a staff member), but it stands apart from an otherwise consistently positive set of reviews naming specific servers for attentive, well-timed service.

locations.name: Studio Movie Grill Dallas Royal Lane
locations.description: Studio Movie Grill's Royal Lane location in Dallas. Reviews are mixed: some describe genuinely strong service recovery (a comped meal after an undercooked item, replaced with vouchers), while others describe malfunctioning seat-side call buttons and a small auditorium with noticeably brighter ambient lighting than expected. One reviewer who regularly visits a competing chain (LOOK) rated this location's seat recline and spacing as worse by comparison. Food/drink pricing draws repeated complaints as high for the portions.

locations.name: Studio Movie Grill Pearland
locations.description: Studio Movie Grill's Pearland-branded location, actually addressed in Houston. Reviewers who compare it to a local competitor (Star Cinema Grill) generally rate this one lower — several note seats that don't reliably recline, a facility described as overdue for renovation, and food items (fries, tenders, coconut shrimp) that taste pre-packaged rather than made fresh. Staff and service are still rated positively across most reviews, and the automatic 18% gratuity is repeatedly described as earned given how many staff interactions a typical visit involves.

locations.name: Studio Movie Grill Plano
locations.description: Studio Movie Grill's Plano location. A mixed bag by theater room: one reviewer flagged a large hole in a theater's ceiling near a specific row, and several note that older, non-reclining seats are still in use in some rooms alongside updated ones elsewhere. Food and ticket pricing are generally called reasonable to cheap. One reviewer's food/drink order took roughly an hour to arrive despite ordering promptly, with billing errors on top; another visit went smoothly with fast, friendly service.

locations.name: Studio Movie Grill Spring Valley
locations.description: Studio Movie Grill's Spring Valley location in Dallas. Individual staff (Jahir, Josue among others named) draw consistent, specific praise for attentive service. Seat and equipment condition varies by visit — one reviewer's seat wouldn't hold its reclined position and their call button didn't work, and sticky seating was noted before any food had even been ordered. A couple of reviews describe order and dessert mix-ups during busy periods, generally resolved by a manager when escalated.

locations.name: Studio Movie Grill The Colony
locations.accessibility_notes: Hosts sensory-friendly showings; reviewed positively by a parent of a neurodivergent child as welcoming and well-accommodated.
locations.description: Studio Movie Grill's The Colony location. Notable for hosting sensory-friendly showings — a parent of a neurodivergent child described the environment as welcoming, patient, and genuinely accommodating, a recurring differentiator in reviews. Food is generally well reviewed, though the swing-out tray tables on the recliners are called cramped by at least one reviewer who preferred the chain's older shared-table layout, and there's a specific complaint about being charged full price after a "Dinner for 2" deal item was removed rather than having the discount preserved.

locations.name: Studio Movie Grill Tyler
locations.description: Studio Movie Grill's Tyler location is a real outlier in this chain's review set: recent reviews are consistently and specifically negative about facility condition, describing a musty smell in the hallway and auditoriums, sticky tables and cupholders, and seat leather that's peeling or torn across most rooms. One reviewer relays a staff member's account that repeated requests to management and corporate for updates have gone unanswered, and unfavorably compares the location to a sister Jacksonville theater. Food and drink quality are still rated well when reviewers look past the facility issues, and one theater room (7) was specifically noted as being in noticeably better condition than others, so experience may vary by which auditorium you're assigned.
